scenicChapters.title: Lake Thun and Lauterbrunnen Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 19 km this is Lake Thun and Lauterbrunnen Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 29 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

lake-thun-and-lauterbrunnen-route.story: A one-way ride of 71 km, Thun to Lauterbrunnen - roughly 1 h 13 in the saddle. The stops in between: Spiez and Interlaken. The highest point is about 2,150 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
